description: A payment form built entirely from the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5, the same components the grid mounts to edit cells composed into a page. SvMaskedInput takes the card number, expiry and CVC with masks, SvCountryInput picks the billing country, SvNumberInput shows the amount with a currency prefix and grouping, SvSwitchButton saves the card and SvButton submits, with live card-brand detection from the number and validation gating the pay button. Copy the file and wire pay() to your provider.

faq.question: How is the card number masked?
faq.answer: SvMaskedInput with mask '#### #### #### ####' formats as you type and reports both the masked and the raw digits through onChange; expiry and CVC use shorter masks the same way.

faq.question: How is the card brand detected?
faq.answer: A $derived tests the raw digits against the leading-digit patterns for the major brands and shows the matching logo, so it updates on every keystroke without a library.

faq.question: Are these components part of the grid package?
faq.answer: Yes. Every control here is exported from the MIT @svgrid/grid package and doubles as a grid cell editor, so a form and a grid in the same app share one component set and theme.
